items.title: AI assistants in the legal sector
items.summary: There is a prevailing assumption in the AI industry that massive frontier models will eventually consume all vertical applications. We routinely see out-of-the-box reasoning capabilities from general models threatening specialized tools, such as . The logic dictates that as frontier models advance, specialized tools will lose their moat.

items.title: Composer 2.5
items.summary: But at least in software engineering, we're seeing a move in the opposite direction, as seen with the recent release of , Cursor's specialized coding model.

items.title: Coding Agent Index
items.summary: Despite costing a fraction of the price, Composer 2.5 delivers comparable results on complex engineering tasks. It scores a 62 on the Artificial Analysis , standing shoulder-to-shoulder with models that cost up to 60 times more per task.

items.title: Tinker
items.summary: But I expect the market to evolve so that more companies can create their specialized AI stack with products that make model fine-tuning cheaper and more accessible. A prime example of this infrastructure maturation is , a tool launched by Thinking Machines.
